title: James Scholars Foundations: Navigating Your First Semester in Honors

sections.note: Not sure what to major in? Have several interests but don't know how they fit together? Wondering how to turn what you care about into a meaningful academic and career path? In this course, you'll explore who you are, what matters to you, and what kind of future you want to build. Through hands-on activities, creative brainstorming, conversations with peers, and real-world experiments, you'll discover how your values, interests, strengths, and skills can help guide your decisions. You'll explore majors and careers, test out possibilities, and learn practical strategies for making decisions - even when you don't have all the answers. There's no single right path and no expectation that you'll have everything figured out by the end. Instead, you'll leave with a better understanding of yourself, new possibilities to consider, and concrete next steps for moving forward.
sections.title: Designing Your Path
